name: Quality Foods Distributing LLC
old_description: Quality Foods Distributing serve as the premier distributor of natural, organic, sustainable and locally-produced products across Montana and the Northern Rockies region. We offer a great selection of the highest quality products, including exceptional regionally made goods that invest in our local talents & economy. We provide consistent, reliable service and support to a wide variety of businesses and institutions.
about:
Quality Foods Distributing is based in Bozeman, Montana, and was founded by Randy and Nancy Lindberg after they relocated to the area to establish a distribution service for the Northern Rockies. The company is privately owned by its co‑founders, who brought decades of experience from the natural products industry, including Randy’s leadership of Nature’s Best and a subsequent executive role at United Natural Foods, Inc.

The business operates as a wholesale distributor of natural, organic, sustainable, and locally produced foods across Montana and the broader Northern Rockies region. It provides logistics, on‑time delivery, and sales support to move products from regional producers to retail and foodservice customers. The company emphasizes building lasting relationships with both suppliers and buyers, and it works directly with ecologically minded farmers and ranchers to source fresh, high‑quality goods.

Quality Foods Distributing serves a diverse customer base that includes grocery stores, restaurants and coffee shops, universities and hospitals, as well as hotels, lodges, and national parks. These segments are explicitly listed on the company’s website as the primary markets it supports.

The founders state that their motivation is to connect local producers with a larger marketplace, ensuring that great regional products find their way to shelves and kitchens. They differentiate themselves through reliable logistics, hassle‑free customer service, and a commitment to investing in the local economy and community.
